scripts.dev: bun run scripts/generate-skills-index.js && bun run scripts/generate-sites-index.js && bun run scripts/generate-extensions-index.js && vite
scripts.build: bun run scripts/generate-skills-index.js && bun run scripts/generate-sites-index.js && bun run scripts/generate-extensions-index.js && vue-tsc && vite build
scripts.lint: bun run lint:oxlint && bun run lint:eslint
scripts.format: prettier --write --experimental-cli src/ scripts/ public/content/ supabase/functions/ .github/ vite.config.ts postcss.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check --experimental-cli src/ scripts/ public/content/ supabase/functions/ .github/ vite.config.ts postcss.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.generate:previews: bun run scripts/generate-sites-index.js && bun run scripts/generate-site-previews.js
scripts.generate:previews:missing: bun run scripts/generate-sites-index.js && bun run scripts/generate-site-previews.js
scripts.generate:previews:all: bun run scripts/generate-sites-index.js && bun run scripts/generate-site-previews.js --all
